name: kube-score
description: Kubernetes object analysis for security and reliability best practices

kube-score.description: Kubernetes object analysis for security and reliability best practices
kube-score.usage:
kube-score score deployment.yaml # Score single file
kube-score score --output-format ci # CI-friendly output
kube-score score --ignore-test pod-networkpolicy manifests/ # Ignore specific tests
kubectl apply -f - --dry-run=client | kube-score score -
